projects.title: IF-Club
projects.description: Developed a project focused on academic integration through the creation of a social network for researchers at IFMA – Campus Caxias. The platform was designed to connect students and professors from different fields, enabling collaboration, idea sharing, and interaction on research and innovation projects. The initiative contributed to improving communication and encouraging interdisciplinary work within the institution.
